title: ardisia neohyalina
intro: Ardisia neohyalina, commonly known as the Himalayan ardisia, is a medicinal plant species belonging to the family Myrsinaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ardisia neohyalina include analgesic, antipyretic, and antioxidant effects, making it a valuable resource in natural medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
